line: A claim, then its proofs at growing scale, then the objection answered.
thread: one figure from the brief, first stated, then sourced, then shown at work
beats: the claim with one hard fact
the mechanism shown once, the product working
proof at one scale: a figure with its source
proof at a second scale: users of different sizes, one fact each, only from the brief
the objection answered: safety, price or switching
the ask with one new fact
fake: Proofs that are adjectives in cards repeat the claim instead of proving it.

line: The old way pictured, then the same thing after, then what changes for the reader.
thread: one object shown before and after: a receipt, a night's count, an inbox
beats: the pain in the buyer's words
the old way as a picture of the object
the turn: the same object after, its heading answering the one before
what changes, as an outcome with a number
the first small step
the close returns to the opening line, resolved
fake: A generic frustration paragraph followed by a feature grid shows nothing that changed.

line: The product along the path of the work, one step a section, ending on the result.
thread: one task or record carried from the first step to the result
beats: what it is, with its central view
the first step a user takes
n: each next step, the product in that step's state
the result at the end of the path
price or plan
the close
fake: Features in any order with one screenshot repeated never let the reader see the work move.

line: Named chapters announced up front, each on the same scaffold, use before machine.
thread: the chapter names, listed in the hero and in a progress nav from five chapters
beats: the hero with the chapters listed as links or tabs
n: one chapter each: its name, a headline with a turn, the product in that chapter's state, one fact
the specs or the machine last
the price
the idea or the makers
the close
fake: Labels painted on unrelated bands, with no contents and no change of state, are kickers, not chapters.

line: A day, a stay or a session in order, each section a time with what happens then.
thread: the hours of the day or the stages of the stay, with real times from the brief
beats: arrival or the start of the day, with the place and one fact
n: each time of day or stage, what the reader does and what they get
the practical part where it falls in the day: hours at the door, price before booking
the end of the day is the ask
fake: Time words pasted onto unrelated sections, or one photograph throughout, let no time pass.

line: A hero line in two halves, each half kept in order, then where they meet.
thread: the two halves named in the hero and nowhere mixed
beats: the hero line in two halves
n: the first half
the hinge: a change of ground or one line naming the second half
n: the second half
where they meet: one price or one picture with both
the close
fake: Interleaving the two halves leaves the reader unsure when the first is done.

line: A signed letter from the people who make it, then what follows from it.
thread: one person's voice, from the greeting to the signature
beats: a plain headline of news or of what is made
the letter: greeting, the reader's situation, the makers' own past, what they did, one honest limit, thanks, a name with role
the practical consequence: dates, how to switch, the cost
questions
a sign-off
fake: An unsigned paragraph of passion in a centred column has no person, no past and no limit.

line: The next version: the object first, then all that changed, then the changes close up.
thread: the predecessor, named, and the one number that changed most
beats: the object itself, before many words
the name and the one-line difference, with a number
everything that changed as one long list
n: the changes that matter, close up, each with a short dry heading and one admission
one dated anecdote as proof
the family or system it belongs to
the spec sheet
fake: New and improved with no predecessor named and no list of changes is not a sequel.

line: The range in one view, in an order that argues, one item opened as the example.
thread: the order of the range: by size, by date, by the buyer's next step
beats: the range in one view, as a picker or an index
one item opened as the example
the rest, one fact each
why buy here: delivery, returns, trial
the close
fake: A grid in no order with reasons in between gives the reader no place to start.

line: The reader picks a need first; the page answers that pick.
thread: the reader's pick, kept visible as the page answers it
beats: a question or a short offer in the hero
the reader's pick, and the answer to it in the same view
what the product does for each moment
people who picked the same, only from the brief
the cost
a close that turns the question back
fake: A picker that changes nothing is a decoration that asks.

line: The reader as the protagonist, from where they are to their own first steps.
thread: the reader, addressed as you, at growing sizes
beats: the reader named as the one who will do it
where people like them work now
others like them at growing sizes, one fact each, only from the brief
the tools that grow with them
the reader's own first three steps, numbered, as the close
fake: You in the headline and a corporate feature list after it ends on contact sales.
